_doc: The plan of a generated city and world/arch.ts civicFor. A building's storeys are its body's (sim/buildings/b40).

plan._doc: The city's shape, authored as the 4.0's world/cityGen/plan.ts has it: no survey behind these numbers. heat = 1 - distance share + density term + noise; the thresholds make it low, medium or high, and commerce on main roads; the works' sector is heavy past industry_high_from of the radius. Parks: park_share of the plan's patches (cells of park_cell_m), none nearer a centre than park_from of the radius: 'the typical city uses 9.8% of its land for parks' (Trust for Public Land's ParkScore as KVIA reports it, kvia.com, read 2026-11-14); only a patch's whole blocks become greens, so the land that ends as park is under the share; the patch's side and the clear middle are authored.

quarters._doc: What a grown building's style is drawn by (sim/buildings/growth.h quarter_seed): the lots of one side of a street within frontage_cell_m share a character (one frontage reads as one) and the lots of an era_cell_m cell share an era, old (0), middle (1) or new (2): within old_core_m of the map's middle the shares are core_eras, outside it edge_eras, as a town is older at its heart. Authored: no survey behind these numbers.

fit._doc: How growth fits a building on a lot (sim/simulation/growth.cpp record_for). tries: [front_m, side_m, share]: the building's lot is the grown lot set back front_m from its front, in side_m from each side, then share of what is left kept about the front's middle; a try stands when no standing building's lot lies over it and the room its plan leaves the blocks is least_room_m a side at least. Each is tried at the lot's density, then at each lower one; a lot nothing fits waits for its streets to change. Authored steps; least_room_m is a room a person can use (the smallest habitable room's least side in the Sao Paulo building code is 2 m, COE Decreto 57.776/2017 Anexo I 5.A; two of them across).
